SharedFlowBundle.name: SF-Token-Retry
SharedFlowBundle.Description: Sends the token request prepared by the calling proxy (message variable tokenRetryRequest) with a per-attempt timeout, and retries up to 2 times (3 attempts in total) with a short delay between attempts, within a global time budget. Retries only on timeout / connection error, 408, 429 and 5xx. The response is left in tokenRetryResponse; a 503 is raised when every attempt failed.
